facts.statement: Migrate Atlas billing from MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL 16.
Production cutover must occur on 2026-09-18 between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC.
Maximum customer-visible write downtime is 90 seconds.
The migration must sustain 500 concurrent writers at p95 latency below 120 ms.
SQLite is permitted only for developer-local fixtures and must never be used in staging or production.
Use logical replication for cutover, but the decision remains provisional until Friday's load test passes.
Rollback if replication lag exceeds 30 seconds for 3 consecutive minutes.
Database credentials must come from Vault path secret/atlas/prod and must not be written to the tape.
Mina owns the migration; Diego is the rollback approver.
Retain audit events for 400 days, but purge raw customer payloads after 7 days.
The migration covers billing writes only; analytics remains on MySQL this quarter.
Success requires zero checksum mismatches across all 48 tenant shards.

Production cutover is fixed for 2026-09-18 02:00–03:00 UTC, with max customer-visible write downtime of 90 seconds.
